# Codex Workbench for DeepSeek Harness
Codex Workbench adds ChatGPT sign-in and subscription quota display to DSH Web. It uses the existing
`openai-codex` provider in DSH 0.2.1-rc.5, so each user signs in with their own account.
## Setup
Install the bundle and restart DSH Web:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Alternatively, install from GitHub with `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Vlad1108/dsh-codex-work
tively, install from GitHub with `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Vlad1108/dsh-codex-workbench`.
Open **Settings → Models**, add the **openai-codex** provider, select **Sign in with ChatGPT**, comp
lete the browser login, and apply the provider settings. The model picker uses the catalog supplied
e browser login, and apply the provider settings. The model picker uses the catalog supplied by DSH.
The composer shows the remaining five-hour quota beside the active Codex model, or the weekly quota
when the account has no five-hour window. Hover or tap it to see the available windows and reset tim
es. Clicking also refreshes the values.
When OpenAI reports saved resets, the quota card shows how many remain. Confirming a reset asks Open
AI to consume one saved reset and restore eligible five-hour and weekly limits; their renewal times
can change. If the response is lost, retry the same request from the card before using another reset
. Availability and eligibility are determined by OpenAI.
Models absent from the bundled catalog can be added through DSH's model settings.
## Web search
The bundle registers and selects the `openai-codex` search provider and selects `http` for fetching
pages. After signing in, `web_search` uses Codex when that tool is enabled for the agent. The select
ion applies to the whole profile, including when another model is active. Disabling the bundle remov
e whole profile, including when another model is active. Disabling the bundle removes its selection.
An existing profile or home `cordis.patch.yml` entry for `web` takes precedence over the bundle. A l
ater bundle may also replace it. To choose another provider, set both `searchProvider` and `fetchPro
vider` in the profile's `web` entry; DSH replaces that entry's whole configuration. Upgrading from 0
.1.1 enables Codex search and HTTP fetching where no later configuration overrides the bundle.
The bundle's configuration provides `searchModel`, `searchMode` (`cached`, `indexed`, or `live`), `s
earchContextSize`, `searchMaxOutputTokens`, and `quotaTimeoutMs`.
## Privacy and compatibility
Credentials remain in DSH's credential store and are never sent to the browser. Sign-in, model reque
sts, quota, and search use OpenAI endpoints. Quota and search use endpoints that may change independ
ently of this plugin. No telemetry is added by this bundle.
This version targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and the Web interface. Use one Codex integration at a time; a se
cond plugin registering the same search provider will conflict.
## Development
Run `pnpm install --ignore-workspace`, `node build.mjs`, `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noE
mit`, and `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts`. The built `lib/` file
s are included so DSH can install the GitHub package without a build step.
MIT licensed; the extracted DSH code retains its original license.
